content: next-themes 0.4.6: ThemeProvider is a client component wrapped around children in the root layout; html element needs suppressHydrationWarning (applies one level deep). Props: attribute ('data-theme' default; use 'class' for Tailwind), defaultTheme ('system' default — pin 'dark' for dark-first), enableSystem (true), storageKey ('theme'), disableTransitionOnChange, themes (['light','dark']), value (map), nonce/scriptProps for CSP. useTheme returns theme, setTheme, resolvedTheme (system resolves to light/dark), systemTheme, forcedTheme, themes. FOUC: injects minified pre-paint script (dev may flash, production does not). Theme-dependent UI must guard on mounted state (server values undefined until mount). Tailwind v4 pairs with attribute='class'. Source: github.com/pacocoursey/next-themes README fetched 2026-09-10.
